name: Detune
body:
School transmutation; Level bard 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one instrument
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

Detune causes a single instrument within range to lose its tuning, giving performance checks with it a –4 modifier. Re-tuning an instrument takes 1d4 full rounds.
